summary: Publish a TypeScript npm library from a pushed version tag with provenance and no stored token, through a rerunnable publish helper.
description: Publish a TypeScript library to npm when a v-prefixed version tag is pushed. The workflow checks the tag against package.json, runs the project's checks, packs the tarball once and publishes exactly that file through npm trusted publishing, so no token is stored. A release script rewrites every place the version lives, and the publish helper checks the registry first so a rerun skips what is already out. First publication, the Trusted Publisher setting and the two-factor setting stay with the package owner.
seoDescription: Tag-driven npm releases for TypeScript libraries: trusted publishing, provenance, a version-bump script and a safely rerunnable publish helper.
